title: JCC game-state-v1
description: Read-only observation snapshot. Structural validation must be followed by the clock, reference, freshness and update checks in docs/specs/game-state-v1.md.
$comment: No image bytes, paths, account names or device identifiers belong in this contract. All refs are local; loading this schema requires no network.

monotonic_ms.description: Milliseconds in the enclosing host_clock_id domain; never wall time.

box.description: Normalized decoded-frame coordinates, top-left origin; positive area is checked by the semantic validator.

device_capture_time.description: Optional independently sourced device capture timestamp. No device/host clock mapping is defined in v1.

observation.description: An atomic field observation. Unknown results still cite the frame assessed or invalidated, even when recognition was not attempted.

round_field.description: Displayed stage-step pair, not scene/phase. No version-specific upper bounds are assumed.

integer_field.description: Displayed integer in HP points or gold units. Mode-specific legal ranges require a verified ruleset.

level_field.description: Displayed player level, not unit star level.

mode_field.description: Verified mode key; unknown mode is null, never an inferred default.

version_field.description: Recognized only when region, season and balance patch are verified for this stream. A third-party dataset alone does not verify the running game.

catalog_ref.description: Scoped data reference; a bare entity_id is not a global identity or proof of current-version applicability.

extensions.description: Namespaced atomic observations, e.g. jcc:price. Consumers must explicitly opt into each extension.

sample_asset.description: Local-only opaque asset reference; hashes identify the exact annotated image bytes, never an earlier unredacted image.

sample_annotation.description: Machine-checkable local sample manifest record, selected via #/$defs/sample_annotation; it is not a game-state snapshot.
